notes:
I can't give you the notes yet, because none of the source pages loaded properly.

I tried to read six pages at once: Enduring Word, three Bible Hub commentaries (Ellicott, Gill and the Pulpit Commentary), Precept Austin and the NET Bible notes. The pages came back in a format my script didn't expect, so it crashed before saving any of the text. I then hit my tool limit for this turn, so I couldn't fix it and try again.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written any verse notes. Anything I wrote now would come from memory, not from the sources.

If you reply (even just "continue"), I'll start again and fetch the pages one at a time so a single bad page can't stop everything. I'll work in this order:
1. **Main readings:** the six pages above, plus StudyLight's commentaries.
2. **Protestant differences:** a quick check of the Reformed, Baptist, Methodist, Lutheran and Pentecostal sites for anything on this chapter. Verse 2 (right and left) and verse 19 ("money is the answer for everything") are the most likely places they'll differ.
3. **Other views:** New Advent and the Bible Odyssey and NET notes, plus a search for prosperity-teaching uses of verse 19, kept only if the sites actually discuss it.

You'll then get the notes verse by verse, with a URL after each point and any verses I find nothing on left out.
